tiles.label: Forest Haze
tiles.promptSeed: Write a brief atmospheric vignette (1-2 short paragraphs) centered on deep forest stillness. Focus on soft sensory details—cool mist, quiet earth, rustling leaves, filtered light. No characters, no conflict, no dialogue. Leave the reader feeling grounded and deeply at peace.
tiles.description: An immersive, quiet description of untouched forest solitude designed to ground the mind.

tiles.label: Silent Water
tiles.defaultTopic: a glassy mountain lake at dawn
tiles.promptSeed: Write a 3-line haiku following a 5-7-5 syllable structure about stationary or slow-moving water (a still lake, a slow stream, gentle rain drops). Focus on clarity, reflection, and quiet grace. No title, preamble, or explanation.
tiles.description: A minimalist, 3-line poem reflecting the serene, glassy quality of tranquil water.

tiles.label: Mountain Breath
tiles.defaultTopic: cool breeze sweeping across high peaks
tiles.promptSeed: Write a short 5-line tanka poem (5-7-5-7-7 syllable structure). The first 3 lines describe a towering, immovable natural landscape (mountains, cliffs, deep valleys), and the final 2 lines offer a quiet, calming realization about steady patience. No title or preamble.
tiles.description: A 5-line poem drawing peace from the timeless, patient endurance of mountains.

tiles.label: Whispering Meadow
tiles.promptSeed: Write a single modern proverb in exactly 2 sentences. Use a physical, peaceful image of a meadow, field, or open sky in the first sentence. The second sentence should quietly extend the thought with a comforting truth about space and quiet. Do not moralize or explain the proverb.
tiles.description: A gentle two-sentence proverb grounded in open fields, grass, and soft skies.

tiles.label: First Light
tiles.defaultTopic: morning sun warming a quiet kitchen
tiles.promptSeed: Write a single daily affirmation in English (1-2 sentences). Written in the first person ('I am...', 'I welcome...'), focus on easing rush, embracing patience, and moving softly into the brand new day.
tiles.description: A positive first-person statement to start the morning without rush or pressure.

tiles.label: Warm Cup
tiles.promptSeed: Write a short, cozy Iyashikei (healing) piece of 2-3 short paragraphs. Focus entirely on a simple morning ritual—breathing in steam from a warm mug, sitting by a quiet window, watching the sunrise. Emphasize warmth, safety, and soft sensory comfort. No tension, drama, or plot.
tiles.description: A cozy, soothing snippet focused on a simple morning ritual like drinking tea or coffee in peace.

tiles.label: Quiet Ritual
tiles.defaultTopic: sweeping the front porch before the city wakes
tiles.promptSeed: Write a gentle modern parable in exactly 3 paragraphs. Describe a character engaging in an unhurried morning habit that seems simple or slow to others. Show time passing peacefully, and finish with a moment that quietly reframes the ritual as a source of deep inner peace. Do not state an explicit moral.
tiles.description: A 3-paragraph story about a slow morning ritual that carries understated weight and peace.

tiles.label: Early Whispers
tiles.promptSeed: Write a single snippet of dialogue (1-2 lines) overheard during the quiet early morning hours. Enclose in quotation marks, followed by a soft setting tag (e.g., '(Overheard at an early bakery)'). The tone should be warm, kind, and calm—a peaceful exchange between early risers.
tiles.description: A short, warm snippet of dialogue overheard in the peaceful hours before the day gets busy.

tiles.label: Twilight Lullaby
tiles.defaultTopic: stars appearing over a quiet house
tiles.promptSeed: Write a short, soothing bedtime story (2-3 short paragraphs). Suitable for all ages, center the narrative on letting go of the day's worries, closing eyes, and resting under a peaceful night sky. Warm, reassuring, and slow-paced.
tiles.description: A reassuring bedtime narrative designed to soothe the mind into restful sleep.

tiles.label: Soft Dusk
tiles.defaultTopic: golden hour fading into deep purple shadow
tiles.promptSeed: Write a short transmission fragment formatted as a distant evening broadcast or quiet night radio beacon (50-75 words). Voice: soft, serene, distant. Sensory details: fading twilight, quiet hums, crickets, cooling evening air. No fear or distress—just a peaceful signal sending goodnight into the dusk.
tiles.description: A calm, ambient radio signal broadcast as night falls.
constraints: Formatted as a gentle radio beacon

tiles.label: Evening Insight
tiles.promptSeed: Write a single, gentle fortune message (1-2 sentences) about the value of rest, letting go of the day, and trusting tomorrow. Optionally include 6 random lucky numbers (between 1 and 59) formatted on a new line about 30-40% of the time ('Lucky Numbers: XX, XX, XX, XX, XX, XX').
tiles.description: A short, comforting fortune encouraging rest, release, and quiet trust in tomorrow.
constraints: Include lucky numbers 30-40% of the time

tiles.label: Starlight Stillness
tiles.defaultTopic: sitting under a sky full of calm stars
tiles.promptSeed: Write a brief atmospheric vignette (1-2 short paragraphs) centered on late-night stillness (a quiet room, moonlight across a floor, a still night sky). Focus entirely on silence, peace, and release. No drama, no dialogue, no conflict—just the feeling of a world safely asleep.
tiles.description: A quiet night vignette highlighting the absolute peacefulness of late night.

[TILE]
